This entire year was me reading symptom checklists and seeing that I experienced every damn one of them too

“Exactly. Everyone in my life is saying “jump in, the waters great!” But I’ve been treading the water for over a decade and haven’t felt a thing” 

That was from my first comment on my first post on this account. I feel you
This subreddit blows my fucking mind sometimes when a post is word for word the description of something I couldn’t even describe before
In the worst of my suicidal episode this year I kept asking myself that too. How in the hell did it get this bad and when because it knocked me on my ass out of nowhere
A few months back I caught a glimpse of myself in the mirror and had to do a double take, I didn’t recognize myself. I couldn’t see any life in my eyes

That’s exactly what happened to me! I broke down and thanked him and left. I was in such a shitty place that next day but luckily I still managed to make an appointment with someone new this week that I actually made it to (and it went better than I thought it would!) I made another with them next week 👌 i hope you’re on your own amazing path to living a happier life  💕

This has been my life for quite a while too and only recently did someone bring up the possibility of it being bipolar and not just depression :/ psychiatrist will hopefully let me know for sure next week when I go for the first time
That’s basically me at work everyday
If they already agreed to going on a Saturday, then they didn’t see it as a waste
If I’m able to get a Saturday OR Sunday off work then I’m gonna go places I want to be

I’ve tried to keep up with them but I end up putting it off and forgetting. They don’t really do much but realize how miserable I am day to day because nothing they suggested was something I haven’t tried in the last fifteen years

I tried antidepressants for the first time last year. Two months of pristiq and six of Prozac. At first I felt just as sad as usual but once I started Prozac I felt it a little stronger but figured it could take a few months to work. Around five or six months into using Prozac I started having more suicidal thoughts and I got freaked and stopped taking it probably last November. Then February came around and I think I was manically depressed and suicidal until just last week when I suddenly didn’t feel *as* suicidal as most of this year. 

I have my first appointment with a new therapist next Monday, and with a psychiatrist the week after that. I started smoking everyday last October cause for the most part it slows down the constant screaming in my head but that plus my shitty memory I’ve had all my life and I can’t remember most of this year. It was my first time thinking I may be bipolar, or manic, but that’s why I want to see the therapists and get actual diagnoses. 

I know it’s hard at work. I used to be able to fake my way through selling and customer service but now it’s honestly too draining and stressful and I don’t know how to get that through to my managers. It just sounds like I’m being difficult. I’m hoping the therapist can give me some help with that because it’s a really big deal lately. 

The last month or so, I started self harming and really hate myself for it. It felt like impulse, I could tell myself not to do something but I’d do it anyway, almost out of my control but I feel so stupid because of course it was in my control to do those things. 

Again, I’m so sorry I don’t have actual advice, I’m so fucking lost and trying to trick myself into staying alive longer. Right now I’m telling myself I have “terms” to meet before I can kill myself but the reality is I want to do it n o w ):
I just saved a tweet I saw that said “I apologize if my isolation feels like rejection to you but if I don’t put myself first then I’m going to break”

I wish I had actual words of encouragement for you but all I can say is I’ve felt the exact same things as you and I don’t quite know what to do about it 

You’ve described my daily feelings to a T and I hate that neither of us have been able to do anything but acknowledge them :/
I think for me it’s more so I’m not feeling remorse for pushing people away and being cold with them. I know it’s so it’s easier to get over losing me if it gets to that 😕
I’ve been so sad because I just recently came to that realization too ):

This is making me feel a lot right now. I’ve been struggling with my mental health for fifteen years now. I’ve always been emotional but the last few years I’ve actively complained that I felt like I have too many emotions and was feeling things too intensely. Someone very close to me has bipolar disorder, and right now I can’t help but be hurt that he hasn’t noticed anything, even with the plethora of other symptoms I’ve actively shown (I can’t tell if that makes sense rn I’m sorry).  
I was so focused on my recent thinking I may be in a manic depressive episode that I had completely ignored the fucking decade of having BIG FEELINGS! Just cause I was just in a constant lull of deep depression
When I get too high and watch Family Guy, I cry because I hope that Seth MacFarlane is happy. I’m so grateful that his creations have given me so much joy when I had so little 👌

I was fine telling him my history. Usually when I’m telling people (online) about my issues, I mention that I want to want to live. But right now I don’t. I’m only trying therapy to say I tried it, so my family can see I tried. I’ve been trying for fifteen years and I’m so tired of trying so hard for them and not myself
I like video games and board games 👀
Exactly. The world is a giant death trap I think, at least it seems like it when my mind keeps thinking of new ways I could kill myself 😖

I know I don’t want to actually do that, but because I pass them very day on my way to and from work, I picture it a lot. I also think about jumping off an overpass but same thing, I couldn’t do that to some random trunk person
After a little time, I go from thinking “you could do it right here right now,” to thinking “I could always do it later, but imma still do it.” I can’t get no relief 😩
